newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Dec 12.

text.p: While polling takes place in two parliamentary by-elections -- to choose MPs for Westminster and for Strasbourg -- the Commons on Thursday will wind up a two-day debate on the European Union.
The by-elections are expected to see Labour retaining a safe seat in Barnsley East to return Jeff Ennis to the Commons, and also winning the Euro-seat of Merseyside West.
- Statement on future business at 1530 GMT.
- Europe debate starting after the business statement and ending at 2200 GMT.
- BSkyB and the ITV Association give evidence to the National Heritage Committee on the BBC and the future of broadcasting, 1030 GMT.

- Alistair Burt, Minister of State at the Department of Social Security, gives evidence to House of Commons Social Security Committee on unfunded pension liabilities in the European Union. 1615 GMT -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
